name: g-line
description: Live status under Claude Code's prompt, and receipts on the turns themselves: context jumps, cache rebuilds and tool failures marked on the turn's own closing line; model, effort, cache countdown and usage pace on the hint line plus one coloured row; heads-up notifications before the cache goes cold; a local dashboard of usage, sessions and history. A mod: no transcript parsing.

lines.title: Layout
lines.description: 2: figures at the end of the hint line plus one coloured row under it. 1: the hint line only. receipts: no footer, just receipts, spinner and heads-ups (keeps another status line you like)

preset.title: Layout
preset.description: For the one-line layout: minimal, default or full (adds bars, git, cost and time)

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Nerd Font icons before each segment

toasts.title: Heads-up toasts
toasts.description: Toasts in the terminal: before the cache goes cold, when a limit is on pace to run out, repeated tool failures, compaction

notifications.title: Native notifications
notifications.description: Desktop notifications for the high-value heads-ups (cache about to go cold, a usage window reset) so they reach you in another app

receipt.title: Turn receipt
receipt.description: What each turn's closing line adds: adaptive (the cost and cache reads, or what was unusual: a context jump, a large cache write, repeated failures), short (cost, cache, tools), full or off
